notes.title: Patch of Heaven v1.1 - Achievements, UI & more!
notes.notes:
Hello, gardeners!

First of all, we want to thank you for all the support and love you've given our little corner of peace. We've been carefully reading your feedback and working to make your experience even more relaxing and customizable. That's why we're thrilled to announce the arrival of version 1.1, packed with new features and quality-of-life improvements!

Here is everything new you will find:



Main Features



Steam Achievements Unlocked! Let the collecting begin! We've added 24 new achievements for you to celebrate your gardening milestones. From watering your first plants to becoming a master decorator, your efforts will now be recognized!

More Life and Style for Your Nursery

New Plants: We've added beautiful new species for you to discover, grow, and care for.

New Decorations: Expand your creative options! We've included a fresh selection of ornaments for you to personalize your space just the way you like it.



Quality of Life Improvements and Options



Pause Menu Redesign: We've updated the pause menu interface to be cleaner, more intuitive, and visually pleasing, maintaining the game's relaxing atmosphere.

Option to Hide Clouds: Prefer a perpetually clear sky? You can now find an option in the pause menu to hide the clouds and enjoy a clearer view.

Change the Nursery Size! One of our most requested features! You can now adjust the size of your nursery directly from the menu, allowing it to better fit your screen and playstyle.

Multi-monitor Support: For our players with more than one screen, we've added an option that will allow you to easily switch which monitor the game is displayed on.

We hope you enjoy these new features as much as we enjoyed creating them. We would love to see how your nurseries grow with the new plants and decorations, so don't hesitate to share your creations with the community!

Your feedback is very important to us, so please keep sharing your ideas to make Patch of Heaven the most relaxing place possible.



Your creativity is our biggest inspiration! Join our Discord community to suggest the next plants and decorations you'd love to see in your nursery. https://discord.gg/zvbnxwPXDK



The Patch of Heaven Team.

notes.title: Patch of Heaven v1.0 - What's Next?
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support! 
We are grateful for all your support and want to keep improving the game for you. Therefore, we encourage you to report all bugs and issues found with Patch. If you can comment here, that's great; otherwise, we invite you to our Discord to report them. We'll leave the link below.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637554/3ed835ca31f52feb70c667cccc63be1c146ba2a4.jpg"]
Future Features
The features will be implemented gradually, and we will announce which ones are being released from time to time.

Toggle Clouds On/Off - For those super minimalist users.

Nursery Scale - For those who want to adjust Patch's size to their liking.

More decorations - In this case, more is better.

Custom Asset Uploads - Far in the future, we will be implementing a tool that will allow you to upload your own creations.


Upcoming Fixes
These are already on our radar thanks to the messages we have received:

UI Update - We've noticed that some words don't do justice to their corresponding actions.

Blue Bird Decoration - The little bird dances off to infinity and beyond if the nursery is moved.

Pot Fixes - In rare cases, pots could be placed in strange spots on the screen.

If you find more bugs, we're here to help!



Join our Discord to share suggestions, report problems, and much more. Discord Link: 

https://discord.gg/zvbnxwPXDK
